entries.clue: Little Miss so small she lives in a mousehole at Home Farm; minute indeed
Women's shoe open at the heel, held on by a thin band around it
Cushioned inner layer your foot rests on inside a shoe, often removable
Full of clatter and blare, and best measured in decibels
Round yellow Mr Man whose grin runs clean from ear to ear; brimming with cheer
Blue Hargreaves character in a permanent bad mood, scowling at the weather
Fleece-lined sheepskin boot of Australian surf culture, now a global brand name
Flat granite plate resting on stone piers in Dartmoor's ancient bridges
Slanting line anchored to the ground to hold a half-built tower steady
Laden beast that gave its name to narrow, low-walled Pennine bridges
